run_detection_job_on_cluster: run the detection transformer training job on a Slurm cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_detection_training_with_trainer: submit a detection training job to the cluster using the Trainer class and AutoExecutor
parse_detection_args: parse command line arguments for detection training including partition, GPUs, nodes, timeout, and job directory
setup_trainer_checkpoint_recovery: setup the Trainer checkpoint method to requeue a failed job and resume from the last checkpoint file
configure_executor_parameters: configure the submitit executor with GPU count, memory, CPU, node, and partition parameters for cluster submission
